MiDeck - User Manual
====================

Requirements
------------

MiDeck requires two configuration files:

- config.json
- func.py

This build includes a `default_config` folder containing both files with a default configuration.

You can use these files directly or modify them to create your own MIDI mappings and actions.

First command
---------------

.\mideck.exe .\default_config\func.py .\default_config\config.json

This will launch MiDeck default files. If you press central C (C5) on your MIDI controller, MiDeck will print "Connected"
